links.outcome: Safety and hallucination detection on PatientSafeBench, MedSafetyBench, and MedHallu with a pre-release risk gate versus baselines
links.effect: Framework releasing responses only when SRA and HRA are <=2 consistently outperformed strong baseline models including GPT-4o-mini; no numeric results in the abstract.
links.quote: Across these benchmarks, the framework consistently outperforms strong baseline models, including GPT-4o-mini, demonstrating the importance of context-aware, risk-based, inference-time safety mechanisms for reliable deployment in healthcare.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent inference-time guardrail with controller agent, dual risk assessment (clinical safety and hallucination) and iterative refinement before release

screen.practice: inference-time risk-gated output filtering with multi-agent safety guardrails
screen.reason: Evaluates CareGuardAI, an inference-time guardrail framework using multi-agent risk assessment and safety filtering for patient-facing LLM question answering, on safety and hallucination benchmarks.

primary.practice: multi-agent inference-time safety guardrails and risk evaluation
